adjusts.description: Output relay of the load channel (INSTR:RELAY)
adjusts.name: output

facts.text: A2D_Eload is the class that controls the A2D electronic load with pyvisa commands over the RS485 bus
The class declares max_channels = 32: at most 32 eloads are connected on the RS485 bus
initialize() splits the *IDN? reply into manufacturer, model number, serial number and firmware version
A model number containing 'Eload' sets max_current to 10.0 A
set_current writes 'CURR {channel},{current_setpoint_A}' and takes the absolute value of a negative setpoint
toggle_output writes 'INSTR:RELAY {channel},1' or 'INSTR:RELAY {channel},0'; closing the relay also sets the current to 0 first and writes the stored setpoint again
get_output queries 'INSTR:RELAY {channel}?' and converts the reply to bool
measure_current returns the target current from 'CURR {channel}?' multiplied by -1
set_led and set_fan write 'INSTR:LED {channel},1/0' and 'INSTR:FAN {channel},1/0'; get_led and get_fan query 'INSTR:LED {channel}?' and 'INSTR:FAN {channel}?'
get_rs485_addr and set_rs485_addr read and write 'INSTR:RS485'

measures.description: Supply voltage measured by the load (MEAS:VOLT)
measures.name: voltage

measures.description: Supply voltage measured by the load's ADC (MEAS:VOLT:ADC)
measures.name: adc_voltage

measures.description: Target current as the load reports it (CURR); the reply is negative while the load sinks current, and the clone multiplies it by -1 to obtain the positive setpoint
measures.name: current_reported

measures.description: Temperature value the load reports (MEAS:TEMP); the clone does not state its unit or scale
measures.name: temperature

safe_state.description: output relay open and the current setpoint zero (the load does not sink current)
